Venue: Gate
Headline: Weekend Power Station: Register to Claim 0.5 NVDAG, Trade to Earn Another 1 NVDAG

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Weekend Power Station is now open for a limited time. Register for a chance to claim the 0.5 NVDAG lucky gift, complete futures trading over the weekend to unlock check-in rewards, and share a total pool of 12 NVDAG. Trade for a chance to receive an additional 1 NVDAG grand prize.
Join Now
## Event Period: November 21, 2026, 00:00 – November 22, 2026, 23:00 (UTC)
## Event 1: Registration Lucky Gift, 0.5 NVDAG per Person
The 33rd, 333rd, 3,333rd, and 6,333rd users to register for this event will each receive 0.5 NVDAG.
Note: Winners of Event 1 must complete a futures trade of any amount during the campaign period to claim their rewards.
## Event 2: Weekend Check-In, Share 12 NVDAG
During the event, users can claim 0.003 NVDAG for every $10,000 in Futures trading volume. Each user can claim once per day. Rewards are automatically credited. The total prize pool is 12 NVDAG and is available while supplies last.
## Event 3: Trading Sprint, Claim Up to 1 NVDAG
During the event, users with Futures trading volume ≥ $1,000 can enter the lucky draw. Users who reach multiple trading volume tiers can enter the lucky draw for each eligible tier. If selected in multiple tiers, only the reward for the highest tier will be issued.
Note: The button text for Event 3 is fixed and will not change after tasks are completed.
≥ $1,000 | 0.05 NVDAG per person | Select 1,000 Users
≥ $10,000 | 0.5 NVDAG per person | Select 100 Users
≥ $100,000 | 1 NVDAG per person | Select 5 Users
## WCTC S9 Registration Is Open
Unlock a prize pool of up to 6,000,000 USDT. Team up, compete solo, or join Event Contracts PK battles. Log in for 1 free launch chance. Register the campaign and conquer the trading summit.
## Important Notes
- All participants must click [Join Now] to register and complete Identity Verification before the event ends to claim rewards.
- Trading Volume = Buy Amount + Sell Amount. During the USD1 futures trading pair fee discount promotion, futures trading volume for the relevant promotional pairs will be calculated at 50%. Event 2 check-in counting period: Each day from 00:00:00 to 23:59:59 (UTC) counts as one check-in day.
- Rewards for this event will be distributed as NVDAG spot tokens. Event 2 rewards will be credited automatically after tasks are completed, on a first-come, first-served basis. Rewards for Events 1 and 3 will be credited to users' accounts within 14 business days after the event ends.
- Market makers, corporate accounts, and institutional accounts are not eligible to participate in this event.
- Gate will review account activity, transactions, and fund transfers during the event. Violations include participating repeatedly through multiple accounts, identity impersonation or submission of false verification information, wash trading or matched trading, circular transfers of on-chain funds, coordinated reward abuse, repeated fund transfers, and any other activities that compromise the fairness of the event. Gate reserves the right to disqualify users found to have engaged in such violations from receiving rewards.
- In the event of any discrepancy between the translated version and the original English text, the English version shall prevail.
- Gate reserves the right of final interpretation.
- Users in the United Kingdom and other restricted regions cannot use all or part of the services, including participation in this event, game, or competition. For details on restricted regions, please read User Agreement . Please note that we do not intend to solicit or market to customers in such restricted regions.

Complete eligible spot or futures trading tasks to receive guaranteed ARK rewards while earning Credits. Credits determine your proportional share of each event’s ARK reward pool—the more Credits you earn, the larger your reward.

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Dear Biconomy Users,
The KITE Futures Carnival is officially live! Trade KITEUSDT Perpetual Futures, complete campaign tasks, and unlock tiered rewards worth up to 2,130 USDT.
Trade KITEUSDT Perpetual Futures, reach trading volume milestones, complete campaign tasks, and earn more rewards throughout the campaign.
## 📅 Campaign Period
November 21 — November 27, 2026 (UTC)
## 🎁 Total Prize Pool
Up to 2,130 USDT in Futures Coupons
- Task Rewards: Up to 110 USDT
KITE Futures Trading Milestone: Up to 2,020 USDT
## 💠 Trading Pair
KITE Perpetual Futures
## How to Join
- Register or log in to your Biconomy account.
- Complete campaign tasks and trade KITEUSDT Perpetual Futures during the campaign.
- Unlock trading volume tiers to earn Futures Coupons — the more you trade, the more you win.
## Task Rewards (Up to 110 USDT)

Cumulative Deposit ≥ 100 USDT | 5 USDT Futures Deduction Coupon
Cumulative Deposit ≥ 200 USDT | 50 USDT Futures Coupon
Invited Friends ≥ 1 | 5 USDT Futures Deduction Coupon
First ZBTUSDT Futures Trade | 50 USDT Futures Coupon
Trading Volume Tiers (Up to 2,020 USDT)
Tier | Volume (USDT) | Reward (Futures Coupon)

## Terms & Conditions
- Trade KITEUSDT Perpetual Futures during the campaign. Cumulative trading volume includes both opening and closing orders, as well as Long and Short positions.
- Unlock trading volume milestones to earn Futures Coupon rewards. Higher cumulative trading volume unlocks higher reward tiers.
- Rewards from all unlocked tiers are cumulative. For example, if a user reaches 10,000 USDT in cumulative KITEUSDT Futures trading volume, they will unlock the corresponding milestone and receive the total rewards from all unlocked tiers.
- Complete campaign tasks to earn additional rewards, including Cumulative Deposit Tasks, First KITEUSDT Futures Trade, and Invite Friends.

- Only filled orders count toward trading volume. Cancelled orders will not be counted.
- Futures Coupons may be used as trading margin. Profits generated using Futures Coupons are withdrawable, while the coupons themselves are non-withdrawable.

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Dear users: The Hibt Spot Hot Coin Carnival is officially open! Trade the 10 most popular spot currencies and win multiple rewards!

Event period: November 19, 2026, 16:01 — November 26, 2026, 15:59 (UTC)
II. Participating Currencies
DOGE/USDT, FIST/USDT, PI/USDT, BTW/USDT, S/USDT, WALLET/USDT, PROS/USDT, TIBBIR/USDT, SHIB/USDT, STONK/USDT
III. Activity Rules
Activity 1: Transaction Volume Ranking Competition
Rewards will be distributed based on user rankings for cumulative spot trading volume (buy + sell, converted to USDT) of 10 designated cryptocurrencies during the event period.
Ranking | Rewards (USDT)
1st place | 800 bonus + 200 real money
2nd place | 500 bonus + 150 real money
3rd place | 300 bonus + 100 real money
4th-10th place | 200 bonus + 50 real money
11th-20th place | 100 bonus + 20 real money
Activity Two: Currency Check-in Task
For every ≧100 USDT spot transaction completed by a user in a single cryptocurrency, it is considered as "checking in" for 1 cryptocurrency.
- Check in for 3 cryptocurrencies: 3 USDT spot trading discount coupon + 5 USDT event contract prediction coupon
- Check-in for 6 cryptocurrencies: 5 USDT spot trading discount coupon + 5 USDT event contract prediction coupon + 5 USDT event contract compensation coupon
- Check in for 10 cryptocurrencies (complete all cryptocurrencies): 10 USDT spot trading discount coupon + 10 USDT event contract prediction coupon + 10 USDT contract discount credit
Activity 3: First Payment Incentive for New Users
New users making their first spot trade on Hibt during the promotion period: Complete a spot trade of ≧50 USDT in any of the 10 designated cryptocurrencies and receive an additional bonus:
- 5 USDT spot discount coupon + 3 USDT event contract prediction coupon
IV. Risk Control Supplement
- Valid trading volume definition: Only buy and sell transactions of 10 specified USDT spot pairs are counted, excluding wash trades, self-trades, and wash trades by linked accounts;
- Rewards will be distributed within 3 business days after the event ends;
- HiBT reserves the right to final interpretation of this event.
